ai_settings.memory_desc: Personalize the long-term memory of your LOUIS ReAct agent. Set global agreements, response styles, or system-wide persona guidelines. Also, review the CRM notes automatically aggregated in short-term memory here.
ai_settings.memory_preferences_placeholder: e.g., You are a professional, tax-sensitive financial assistant. Always reply in English, keep offers in tabular format, and formulate concisely.
ai_settings.memory_db_desc: Maintenance tools for persistent AI contexts, customer profiles, and accompanying RAG background knowledge.
ai_settings.memory_content_placeholder: Enter your knowledge, a conversation summary, or system guidelines here...
ai_settings.memory_rag_checkbox_label: Add directly to the RAG knowledge database (vector short-term memory)
ai_settings.files_upload_desc: Will be provided in the Louis system vault for RAG document processing
ai_settings.files_status_not_indexed_tooltip: No text segments in the RAG index yet
ai_settings.files_status_action_ingest_tooltip: Parse this document and make it available for the Louis AI in the RAG vector storage
ai_settings.notes_empty_user: No internal knowledge notes have been created so far.
ai_settings.stt_desc: Manage your settings for local or cloud-based speech-to-text recognition models (Whisper).
ai_settings.stt_prompt_help: Terminology or names that Whisper should prioritize in order to better understand specialized crm context.
ai_settings.stt_prompt_placeholder: Louis, CRM, Contact, Company, Workflow, BWA, E-Invoice, Invoices
ai_settings.stt_unload_llm_desc: Frees up GPU VRAM intelligently before starting the transcription process.
ai_settings.stt_failsafe_cpu_desc: Automatically falls back to CPU computation if GPU runs out of memory (OOM).
ai_settings.safety_hint_desc: Your API keys are stored in a highly isolated manner for your tenant in the system. Louis CRM AI uses ReAct orchestration to accompany all database activities in real-time, but denies the artificial intelligence direct write permissions on live CRM data.
ai_settings.provider_settings_desc: Manage AI providers, model name, endpoints, API keys and agent fine-tuning.
ai_settings.runtime_section_desc: Controls the token efficiency of the AI agent. Empty fields = backend default.
ai_settings.max_iterations_desc: How many tool-execution rounds the agent may run before answering.
ai_settings.max_history_tokens_desc: How many tokens of the chat history are available to the agent per request (older messages get compressed).
ai_settings.tool_result_truncate_desc: Maximum number of characters with which tool results are embedded into the agent prompt.
ai_settings.early_exit_after_tools_desc: After this number of executed tools the agent is forced to answer (prevents infinite loops).
ai_settings.react_keep_last_results_desc: How many of the latest tool results are shown to the agent in full; older ones get summarized.
ai_settings.react_compaction_from_iteration_desc: From this iteration on, older tool results are summarized compactly instead of being embedded in full.
ai_settings.prompt_directives_desc: Controls whether the detailed email/payment-reminder directives (~600 chars) are always embedded or only for email-related requests.
ai_settings.tool_call_mode_desc: Native tool calls save output tokens (structured calls instead of JSON response). Auto = uses native, falls back to JSON when needed.
ai_settings.text_fallback_on_desc: ON — XML/JSON text fallback allowed (compatible, for models without function calling)
ai_settings.text_fallback_off_desc: OFF — structured tool calls only (strict — no XML leaks)
ai_settings.text_fallback_desc: When OFF, the agent accepts native tool calls only. Some local models (e.g. small Ollama models) need the fallback — enable it here. If a model returns text instead of tool calls while OFF, a hint appears in the chat.
ai_settings.memory_budget_desc: Maximum tokens for long-term memory (preferences + notes) in the agent prompt. Empty = 800 (default). Older notes are truncated when exceeded.
ai_settings.parallel_tool_guidance_desc: Instruction for batching independent read tools in the prompt (ON = guidance included).
ai_settings.tool_guidance_trim_desc: Inject email/reminder directives only when email tools are active or the request has email intent (saves tokens, stable prefix).
ai_settings.memory_frozen_snapshot_desc: Freeze memory once per request (stable cache prefix). OFF = live refresh after update_memory mid-turn.
ai_settings.compression_section_desc: Threshold-based compression of the chat middle with head/tail protection. Runs in the background — never on the response path. Empty fields = backend default.
ai_settings.compression_threshold_desc: Share of the context window at which the middle is compressed. Window size comes from the model map (below) or the 128K default.
ai_settings.compression_tail_desc: The last N tokens of the conversation always stay fully intact (head/tail protection).
ai_settings.compression_aux_empty_hint: Fetch the model list in the main section first — the aux model is chosen from the same list.
ai_settings.compression_aux_desc: Cheaper model for summary calls (aux path, not in the main loop). Empty = main model.
ai_settings.compression_persist_on_desc: ON — summary + trimmed history are stored in the session DB (recall stays possible)
ai_settings.compression_persist_off_desc: OFF — compress in the running process only, nothing persisted
ai_settings.compression_map_desc: JSON map: regex pattern → context window (window_tokens) + optional threshold (threshold_percent). Empty = backend default (known model families, 128K fallback). Models with a window ≥ 512K count as native context management and are passed through without own compression.
ai_settings.memory_prefetch_desc: Load relevant memory entries first per request (not just budget injection).
ai_settings.memory_prefetch_timeout_desc: A hanging memory load never blocks the turn (non-fatal).
ai_settings.memory_recall_status_desc: Shows “🧠 recalled N entries” under the answer when prefetch hit.
ai_settings.memory_auto_scan_desc: Blocks credentials/PII/suspicious characters when saving (additive — with 0 hits the existing rules still apply).
ai_settings.memory_consolidation_desc: On overflow, oldest notes are summarized via LLM instead of dropped (in the background).
ai_settings.guards_section_desc: Empty/repetition guards, tool guardrails, hard loop deadline, thinking scrubber. Empty fields = backend default.
ai_settings.tool_call_retry_max_desc: Correction rounds for broken JSON/tool calls (was hardcoded 2 — now admin config).
ai_settings.empty_retry_budget_desc: Empty LLM responses: retries up to this budget, then abort with a clean answer.
ai_settings.empty_retry_cost_desc: Expensive empty streaks abort earlier (estimated cost per attempt).
ai_settings.guardrail_exact_desc: Same tool call with same args failed > N times → hint to the model (fail-open).
ai_settings.guardrail_progress_desc: N consecutive failures without success → strategy hint to the model.
ai_settings.loop_deadline_desc: Hard pipeline deadline: hanging runs terminate guaranteed, answer built from available results.
ai_settings.recall_fts_desc: Weighted ranking (title > summary > content) + recency bonus. OFF = always newest sessions.
ai_settings.recall_limit_desc: Default hit count for recall_sessions when the agent gives no limit (explicit agent limits win).
ai_settings.skills_section_desc: Compact skill injection (budget), curator maintenance (inactive until activated — NEVER deleted).
ai_settings.skill_inject_tokens_desc: Maximum tokens for skill details in the prompt (index name+description always; full content via vault_read).
ai_settings.skill_top_k_desc: Number of relevant skills injected per request.
ai_settings.skill_prune_days_desc: Unused skills are marked inactive (status: inactive) — NEVER deleted, reactivated on use.
ai_settings.curator_interval_desc: How often the skill curator runs (mark inactive + archive). Empty = 24h.
ai_settings.curator_archive_desc: Inactive skills are moved to _louis/skills/_archive/ after N days — NEVER deleted.
ai_settings.questions_answered_feedback: ✓ Question answered — the decision is saved and feeds into the next agent response.
ai_settings.questions_search_no_results: No questions found for the search.
ai_settings.mcp_subagent_section_desc: MCP tool cache (refresh interval, per-call timeout), sub-agent deadline and parallelism.
ai_settings.mcp_refresh_desc: TTL cache for the MCP tool list (no DB read per request). Discovery lock prevents double refresh.
ai_settings.subtask_timeout_desc: Hanging sub-agents terminate guaranteed (checkpointing persists PENDING → SUCCESS/FAILED).
ai_settings.subtask_parallel_desc: Maximum concurrently running sub-agents (was hardcoded 3 — now admin config, rule 12).
ai_settings.subtask_depth_desc: Maximum delegation depth (a sub-agent may delegate up to this level). Empty = 3.
ai_settings.audit_retention_desc: Days after which audit entries are automatically deleted (scheduler prune). Empty = no automatic deletion (recommended for compliance history).
ai_settings.session_retention_desc: Days after which inactive chat sessions are automatically deleted (scheduler prune; children are orphaned). Empty = no automatic deletion.

governance_rules.title: Governance Rules
governance_rules.desc: Control which actions the AI agent may perform. Applies to chat and workflow actions. Strictest rule wins: BLOCK > ASK > REQUIRE_APPROVAL > ALLOW. If no rule matches, the action is allowed.
governance_rules.note_placeholder: Reason / note for the agent (shown to the user on ASK)

action_descs.CREATE: Create new records (e.g. contact, company, invoice)

effect_descs.BLOCK: The agent must NOT execute the action — it will be aborted.
effect_descs.ASK: The agent must ask the user and wait for an answer.
effect_descs.REQUIRE_APPROVAL: The action is created as a draft/proposal and only takes effect after human approval.
effect_descs.ALLOW: The action is allowed without restriction.
